Elena M.: Quick coordination: I'm doing a tidy of the Dedicated Capacity docs to fix a few copy-paste JS/Python/Go snippets, resolve broken handbook links, and add a short migration checklist. Draft PR incoming.
Noah P.: Please call out the correct terraform var name this time — it's `reserved_pool_replicas` (we keep getting `replicas` vs `reserved_pool_replicas`).
Ruth Y.: Also add a one-line note about KMS integration for Private deployments and tag security for review. Sec S. should check we don't expose key material in examples.
docs-bot: link-check: found stale path /handbook/dedicated/old-sla -> 301 -> /handbook/dedicated/sla-and-slos. Also found broken anchor handbook/dedicated/operations.md#preemption-behaviour -> 404.
Elena M.: I'll point SLA links to the canonical /handbook/dedicated/sla-and-slos and update the operations anchor. Adding a TODO to follow up if redirects change.
Noah P.: Snippet fixes: Python should use `client.create_dedicated_capacity(..., scale_policy={'type':'autoscale','cooldown_seconds':300})`. Go snippet should demonstrate ScalePolicy struct.
Elena M.: Draft Python snippet in the doc: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
c.create_dedicated_capacity(name='staging-pool', gpu_type='a10g', replicas=2, scale_policy={'type':'autoscale','cooldown_seconds':300}, isolation='tenant')
```
Ruth Y.: Migration checklist suggestion: 1) provision in staging, 2) run smoke test (50rps, 2 min), 3) rotate automation keys, 4) canary lift in 10% increments with 30m waits, 5) observe 24h. Keep it short.
Elena M.: Adding that. I'll open a draft PR and tag #eng-runtime, #docs-review, and @Sec S. for the KMS note. Will also include a one-paragraph Deep Dive on tenant vs reserved-pool eviction semantics (factual, non-normative).
eng-runtime: Please include a reference to runtime ticket #451 about preemption interaction so we don't publish contradictory behavior.
Elena M.: Will do. Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9988 (draft). Pinged reviewers in the PR.
Noah P.: Sweet. I'll review snippets and confirm var names.
Sec S.: I'll do a quick security pass on the KMS notice and examples.
Elena M.: Thanks all — will post a short changelog in the PR body and mark any follow-up TODOs for post-merge cleanups.
